subject: general
question: If the radius of a sphere is doubled, then the volume of the sphere becomes _____ times the previous volume.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a sphere is proportional to the cube of its radius (V ∝ r³).

Initial radius ratio = 1 : 2

Volume ratio = 1³ : 2³

Volume ratio = 1 : 8

The volume becomes 8 times the previous volume.

**∴ The correct answer is eight.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial radius = r₁

Final radius = r₂ = 2 × r₁

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Sphere (V) = (4/3) × π × r³

 
• r V₁ = (4/3)πr³ 
• r → 2r 
• 2r V₂ = (4/3)π(2r)³ = 8V₁ 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let initial volume be V₁ = (4/3) × π × r₁³

⇒ Let final volume be V₂ = (4/3) × π × r₂³

⇒ Substitute r₂ = 2r₁ in the volume formula:

⇒ V₂ = (4/3) × π × (2r₁)³

⇒ V₂ = (4/3) × π × 8r₁³

⇒ V₂ = 8 × [(4/3) × π × r₁³]

⇒ V₂ = 8 × V₁

**∴ The correct answer is eight.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Surface Area of Sphere

The total surface area of a sphere is given by A = 4 × π × r². If radius is doubled, the surface area becomes 4 times.

Volume of Hemisphere

The volume of a hemisphere is exactly half of a sphere: V = (2/3) × π × r³.

Hemisphere Surface Areas

Curved Surface Area (CSA) = 2 × π × r² | Total Surface Area (TSA) = 3 × π × r².
